{{Event Infobox
|Name=The Lantern Key
|Image=StS2_Mysterious Knight.png
}} {{Small Card Infobox|Lantern Key|2}}
{{E2|The Lantern Key}} is an {{2|Event}} found exclusively in the {{2|Hive}}. It is a combat event. The {{C2|Lantern Key}} can be used in the {{E2|War Historian, Repy}} event in Act 3.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Return the Key}} {{TS|positive||Gain 100 Gold.}}
<br>
{{Frame|Keep the Key}} Enter combat against a {{2|Mysterious Knight}} for the {{C2|Lantern Key}} card.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote>
<div style="font-style:italic">
You come upon a faintly glowing key and go to pick it up.

"Been looking all over for that key! Now if you don't mind..."

This person looks like bad news but maybe it's not good to be judgy.
</div>

{{Frame|Return the Key}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The stranger thanks you for your help, and rewards you handsomely.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Keep the Key}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The stranger looks at you menacingly. It seems like only one of you is making it out of here with the key.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* If you choose to {{Frame|Keep the Key}}, the {{2|Mysterious Knight}} combat counts as a normal combat encounter for purposes such as {{R2|Prayer Wheel}} and will drop normal combat rewards along with the {{C2|Lantern Key}}.

== Mysterious Knight ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Mysterious Knight
|Image  = StS2_Mysterious Knight.png
|HP     = 101
|AscHP  = 108
|Powers = {{BD2|Strength}} 6<br>{{BD2|Plating}} 6
|Debut  = Hive
|Type   = Normal
}}
'''Mysterious Knight''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} encountered in the {{E2|The Lantern Key}} event. It is a stronger version of the {{M2|Flail Knight}} with innate {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Plating}}.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Mysterious Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Breaker
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 3 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Flail
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|10}}) damage x2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ram
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Mysterious Knight|Ram}}, then randomly picks {{Int2|Mysterious Knight|Breaker}} (equal chance), {{Int2|Mysterious Knight|Flail}} (double chance), or {{Int2|Mysterious Knight|Ram}} (double chance). Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

{{Clear}}
